one_line: A wealthy Bengali zamindar-entrepreneur who partnered with British capital in coal, shipping, tea, indigo and opium in the 1830s–1840s.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height, slightly rounded build with an air of cultivated refinement.
appearance.face: Oval face, wheatish Bengali complexion, neatly trimmed sideburns, straight nose, sharp but kind eyes with a thoughtful, calculating gaze, default expression a composed half-smile that suggests both charm and business acumen.
appearance.hair: Glossy black hair, combed back and slightly waved, of medium length above the collar; no turban, instead a simple dark velvet Bengali cap (small, rounded, rimless) worn slightly back on the crown, exposing the hairline.
appearance.costume: He wears a finely tailored early 19th-century Bengali bhadralok ensemble: a long, knee-length white muslin angarkha-style coat with a subtle woven stripe, fastened diagonally with cloth loops over a pale cream cotton kurta; below, a pair of slightly tapered white churidar trousers with gentle folds at the ankles, and on top a rich dark navy silk shawl with a thin gold border draped over his left shoulder and across his chest; his feet in simple black leather slippers with low heels; he has a narrow gold ring on one hand and a plain, functional pocket watch chain just visible at his waist, reflecting his modern, Anglicised habits without Western suit cosplay.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment-style business contract tied with a thin red ribbon, held confidently in his right hand as if mid-negotiation.

ref_desc: Dwarkanath Tagore is a refined Bengali man in his early 40s with an oval wheatish face, combed-back black hair and velvet cap, wearing a white angarkha, churidar and dark navy silk shawl, holding a rolled red-tied business contract in one hand.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Dwarkanath Tagore: a dignified Bengali man in his early forties with an oval wheatish face, neatly trimmed sideburns, and combed-back glossy black hair under a small dark velvet cap worn slightly back. His expression is a composed half-smile, eyes sharp and thoughtful. He wears a knee-length white muslin angarkha-style coat with subtle woven stripes, diagonally fastened over a pale cream kurta, paired with fitted white churidar trousers with gentle folds at the ankles. A rich dark navy silk shawl with a thin gold border is draped over his left shoulder and across his chest. His footwear is simple black leather slippers with low heels, and a faint gold pocket watch chain peeks at his waist, with a narrow gold ring on one finger. In his right hand he confidently holds a rolled parchment business contract tied with a thin red ribbon. Show him in front, side, and back poses to clearly display his face, hair, angarkha, churidar, shawl, slippers, jewellery and the red-tied contract, using a clean palette of white, cream, dark navy, black and gold.
